title: Common providers: Latvia
coverage: Partial. Covers the national fixed-line carrier, the three mobile network operators, the state broadcast and backbone operator and the research network; cable, regional and business ISPs are thin.
missing: Regional and local ISPs outside Riga
Smaller business ISPs and data-centre operators
The regulator's register of electronic communications merchants (not read)

sources.name: SPRK (Public Utilities Commission): electronic communications
sources.terms: The site says all rights to its published content are reserved: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Page read for its address only, in Latvian; the register of merchants was not read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Latvia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 2 of 8 names were found on the page (whole-word match; a name under three characters is not counted).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 8 websites and 0 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 13 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number registered to the provider but not announced was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: Its terms were not read: nothing is copied. Searched by name to find the numbers to confirm.
sources.result: Used to find candidate numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0. An item's id is recorded where the item states one of the entry's AS numbers.
sources.result: 1 ids recorded; an item of a parent group was not used.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Tet (company)

sources.result: States that Lattelecom took the name Tet in 2019.

providers.name: Bite Latvija
providers.notes: Mobile, and cable and fibre under the former Baltcom. AS20910 was Baltcom's number, AS2588 Latnet's, AS28699 Unistar's.

providers.name: LVRTC
aka: Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs
providers.notes: State broadcast and optical backbone operator.

providers.name: SigmaNet
providers.notes: The national research and education network, at the University of Latvia. It was called LATNET until 2008; the Latnet name on a bill is Bite Latvija.
